name: Sielanic Rituals — 3 Advanced — The Protector's Mind

system.description:
This ritual links the caster's mind to that of Telyavel, protector of the dead, used only in dire circumstances such as an invading army threatening the sorcerer's protected realm. Success grants a sizable pool of dice to allot among Physical or Mental Attributes (without exceeding their normal maximums) and lets all of the caster's Disciplines function as if she held one additional level in each, including powers she has not yet mastered. It also lets her remain awake and largely immune to sunlight through the day, so long as she stays out of direct exposure. Failure means the caster fails to reach the death-god's mind; a botch inflicts five levels of aggravated damage and risks a permanent derangement from touching Telyavel's mind too closely without his favor.

System: The caster meditates for an hour to focus her thoughts on Telyavel, then spends the blood cost. The effect, if successful, lasts from one moonrise to the next.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
system.prerequisites: Sielanic Path of the World's Blood
